thread:
matt: heads-up — saw a prod OOM tied to the KV cache on us-west-2-e during a long-context chat. happened right after we rolled the new batching heuristic.
priya: ugh, which heuristic? the adaptive max_tokens one?
jin: yep that roll changed batch packing -> larger average seqs. logs show KV allocations spike + fragmentation.
matt: pasting the key log lines:
```
OOM: alloc failed in kv_slab: requested=524288000 used=231402880 free=0
kv_cache: pages_allocated=4789 fragmented_pages=1324 reuse_hits=12 reuse_misses=4017
batcher: packed_batch_size=18 avg_seq_len=1472
```
alex: reuse_misses that high + fragmented pages strongly suggests compaction hasn't been keeping up. new batcher made longer seqs so kv footprint grows per request.
sam: any immediate mitigation we can flip? reduce batch pack or force compaction?
priya: suggest short-term: rollback adaptive pack -> conservative pack, enable immediate compaction trigger on fragmentation>20%, and enable small-batch retry on OOM.
jin: we should also add graceful degrade: fallback to stateless route (no KV) for requests > N tokens when OOM is detected. avoids full crash.
infra-bot: created incident draft: INC-2026-045. Attaching current pod/core dumps to /artifacts/INC-2026-045/
matt: proposed quick config patch (canary 5%):
```
kv:
  compaction:
    aggressive: true
    fragmentation_threshold: 0.2
  eviction:
    policy: lru_weighted
    emergency_evict_pct: 0.15
  reuse:
    enabled: true
    min_reuse_score: 0.6
batching:
  packer_mode: conservative
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  fallback_on_oom: retry_smaller_batch
```
alex: +1. Also add a retry path where on OOM we immediately retry the request with max_batch_tokens halved and prefix_cache disabled for that request. keep a max of 2 retries.
priya: note: need to ensure retry is idempotent w/ client-visible tokens. set a server-side retry header so SDKs can surface it.
sam: for longer term we should profile kernel selection path: maybe kernel choice for longer seqs is memory-inefficient; add flame graphs for longctx paths.
jin: agreed. I'll run profiler on canary and produce a perf flame + KV page usage heatmap.
oncall-bot: scheduled oncall shift handoff with matt & jin in 30m.
matt: action items: 1) roll canary config above to 5% (jin) 2) add emergency retry & stateless fallback (alex) 3) run kernel+kv profiler on canary (jin) 4) monitor reuse_miss and fragmentation metrics and rollback if regress (priya)
priya: I'll add dashboards/alerts: fragmentation_ratio > 15% for 2m -> pager, reuse_miss_rate delta > 200/min -> pager.
alex: quick note — add a cheap metric: post-oom immediate evict_count to see if emergency_evict_pct helps.
sam: if compaction is too expensive CPU-wise we may need background compaction throttles and a fast path emergency compactor that prefers small contiguous pages.
matt: timeline: canary in next 20m, monitor for 1h, full roll if green.
jin: starting canary now, will post profiler link in thread.
priya: thanks — documenting the playbook in the runbook after we validate.
infra-bot: canary deployed: deployment/kv-runtime-canary v2 -> 5% replicas. logs: /artifacts/INC-2026-045/canary-logs
matt: good. if we see repeat OOMs we will fall back to pinned stateless variant and roll cluster-wide.
jin: profiler upload: /artifacts/INC-2026-045/profiler/flame_longctx.svg (will add notes after analysis)
priya: adding playbook section: steps to toggle aggressive compaction, emergency eviction, and runtime retry headers.
sam: leaving a small note for QA: add long-context synthetic with repeated prefix reuse to confirm reuse counter behavior.
matt: thanks all — will update incident once we have 1h of canary metrics.
